name: Pool House, Germany
lede: A contemporary pool house in a German garden needed heat and light under a lower ceiling than ideal. An Eclipse Electric on an 8-inch pole meets the clearances and makes the lounge a place to dry off after a swim.

hero.caption: The pool house lounge at blue hour. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
The Eclipse heater glowing on the ceiling at dusk. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The pool house, planned with Will Pools & Wellness of Bellheim, uses modern materials and opens onto the garden. Its outdoor lounge is where people dry off after swimming.
The heating had to match the modern look. The ceiling was lower than ideal, the heater had to meet its clearance requirements, and it needed a more substantial power supply.

With Bromic’s complimentary design service, the team chose an Eclipse Smart-Heat Electric on an Eclipse 8-inch straight pole to meet the clearances, and planned in a power line with voltage requirements unusual for Germany.

quote.text: We had to install the correct power line, which had unconventional voltage requirements for Germany.
